method: Source-scoped internal editorial record: checked all 83 sections' identifier, level, source locators, activities, option feedback, assessment scope, visual links, and data-table logic. Mechanism-level text review was targeted; it is not line-by-line qualified external peer review.
limitations: External subject-matter expert approval not obtained
New illustrations are original internal drafts without independent accessibility or browser QA
Textbook per-understanding page pointers were inherited from the prior packages and are not independently page-verified here
Full npm quality/build and browser tests require an executable repository checkout
